# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 26 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 26 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_026_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 1 — Believe in One God

**1** First of all, believe that God is one — who created all things and brought them to completion, who brought all things into existence out of nothing, who contains all things and is himself alone uncontained. **2** Believe in him, therefore, and fear him; and fearing him, practice self-control. Keep these things and you will cast off all wickedness from yourself and clothe yourself with every virtue of righteousness, and you will live to God if you keep this commandment.

---

*LOGOS note: The Mandate begins with creedal monotheism — not a narrative but a theological affirmation, structured as a mini-creed: (1) God is one, (2) creator of all, (3) creator ex nihilo, (4) omnipresent but not contained. The ethical chain (believe → fear → self-control → righteousness → life to God) is the Shepherd's standard moral sequence.*
